title: Mixed review: scope and the tools so far
idea: TOOL. Mixed review: scope alongside variables, loops, and helper-in-a-sum.

exercises.prompt: REVIEW (loops): for the list [2, 4], a running total starting at 0 ends at...
SCOPE: a variable made inside a function is...

Predict:

def f(n):
    doubled = n * 2
    return doubled

print(f(7))
print(doubled) after that call would error.
REVIEW (helper in a sum): arrange correctly.

REVIEW: hand back the value:

def f(n):
    r = n + 10
    ____ r
Which are TRUE about scope? (choose all)
options: two functions can reuse a name
inside names stay after the call
exercises.explanation: The first three are true; inside names vanish when the function ends.

exercises.prompt: REVIEW (return vs print): to USE a result later you need...
exercises.explanation: return hands the value back for later use.

exercises.prompt: Why scope matters for bigger programs:
options: Sub-plans stay independent and safe to combine
exercises.explanation: Independent sub-plans are easy to compose.
